outcome: Placental vascular complications (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, placenta abruption, intrauterine growth restriction, stillbirth)
cohort: The study included 503 women with singleton pregnancies attending first-trimester aneuploidy screening (11+0 to 12+6 weeks) at the Obstetrics Unit of the University Hospital of Modena, in Northern Italy, between June 2018 and December 2019.
finding: A multivariable predictive model incorporating pre-pregnancy BMI >= 30, increasing mean arterial pressure, PAPP-A < 2.40465 U/L, and decreasing PlGf (MoM) was developed to identify women at greater risk for placental vascular complications with satisfactory predictive accuracy (AUC 79.4%).
